method: Standard TIH prompt: Rate this document on a scale of 1-100. Output the score and your reasoning. Five fresh reviews per model per candidate, 15 per round. Published Markdown format includes descriptions of all twelve figures; later candidates also embed their rendered images. Text models are not a visual-design audit.
gate_rule: GPT average stays flat or improves; average of Fable and GLM improves versus the current passing baseline. Numeric TIH compare_score_gate applied without regex interpretation of model outputs.
